subject: Agriculture
title: Biofortification
description: A quick, practical guide to Biofortification.

hook.text: Two billion people suffer from hidden hunger—not calorie shortage, but micronutrient deficiency.

buildup.text: Staple crops like rice and wheat are calorie-rich but nutrient-poor. They fill stomachs but starve bodies.

discovery.text: Biofortification breeds extra iron, zinc, or vitamins directly into food crops—no supplements needed.

twist.text: Orange-fleshed sweet potatoes with high vitamin A are already saving children's eyesight in Mozambique and Uganda.

climax.text: HarvestPlus has released biofortified varieties of 12 crops in 30 countries. Nutrition is bred, not added.

punchline.text: Better nutrition, same seed. The crop does the supplementing.

quiz.question: What is biofortification?
options: Breeding extra micronutrients directly into crop varieties
